overview.current-state: - Components exist with basic functionality and good architecture - Framer Motion already integrated for animations - Tailwind CSS setup with custom neon colors - Basic accessibility features present - Performance optimizations in place (throttling, memoization)
overview.target-state: - Smooth 60fps animations with easing functions - Enhanced micro-interactions for user delight - Complete WCAG AA accessibility compliance - Touch-friendly mobile interface (48x48px targets) - Skeleton loading states and success celebrations - Graceful error handling with user feedback

component.name: MagicCanvas
component.current-issues: - Basic mode toggle without smooth transition effects - Missing zoom controls and touch gestures - Limited accessibility for complex canvas interactions - No performance mode toggle for heavy workloads

enhancements.animation: - Smooth 3D/2D mode transitions with scale/fade effects - Node connection animations with spring physics - Zoom controls with smooth easing (ease-in-out) - Touch gesture feedback with haptic responses
enhancements.accessibility: - Enhanced ARIA labels for canvas regions - Keyboard shortcuts overlay with help modal - Screen reader announcements for node selections - Focus management for complex interactions
enhancements.performance: - Performance mode toggle (reduces animations) - Virtualization for 1000+ nodes - Progressive loading of 3D assets - Memory usage monitoring display

component.name: SmartNotificationCenter
component.current-issues: - Notifications appear abruptly without smooth entrance - No priority-based visual hierarchy - Limited toast positioning options - Basic queuing without intelligent batching

enhancements.animation: - Staggered entrance animations for multiple notifications - Priority-based color intensity and animation speed - Toast slide-in with bounce effect - Auto-dismiss with countdown animation
enhancements.ux-improvements: - Smart notification grouping by category - Snooze functionality with time picker - Quick actions (mark all read, archive all) - Voice announcement for critical notifications
enhancements.accessibility: - ARIA live regions for screen readers - Keyboard navigation between notifications - Focus trapping in notification panel - High contrast mode support

component.timing-specs: - Entrance: 0.3s ease-out with 0.1s stagger - Exit: 0.2s ease-in with scale and opacity - Auto-dismiss: 5s with 1s countdown animation - Hover pause: Infinite while focused

component.name: ProgressPredictionEngine
component.current-issues: - Static progress displays without engaging animations - No skeleton loading for AI analysis - Missing success celebration patterns - Limited visual feedback during processing

enhancements.loading-states: - Skeleton loading with shimmer effects - AI analysis indicator with breathing animation - Progressive data revelation (confidence → scenarios → recommendations) - Success celebration with confetti animation
enhancements.data-visualization: - Animated progress bars with easing - Color transitions based on score changes - Milestone timeline with interactive hover states - Risk level indicators with pulsing effects

component.name: AIFeedbackEngine
component.current-issues: - Feedback appears without context animation - No typing indicator for AI responses - Limited visual feedback hierarchy - Basic dismiss interactions

enhancements.ai-ux: - Typing indicator with dot animation - Confidence visualization with progress rings - Contextual action buttons with hover effects - Feedback card elevation on interaction
enhancements.interaction-patterns: - Swipe to dismiss on mobile - Long press for additional options - Drag and drop to categorize feedback - Voice input for feedback responses

component.name: Header
component.current-issues: - Basic navigation without mega-menu patterns - Static search bar without enhanced UX - Limited responsive navigation - Missing breadcrumb navigation

enhancements.navigation: - Mega-menu with categorized sections - Search with auto-complete and recent searches - Breadcrumb navigation with smooth transitions - Mobile hamburger menu with slide animations
enhancements.search-ux: - Real-time search suggestions - Command palette (Cmd+K) integration - Search result highlighting - Recent searches and quick actions

design-system.typography: Inter font with semantic sizing: 12px-48px range
design-system.colors: Enhanced neon palette with semantic mapping for actions, states, feedback
design-system.shadows: Multi-layer shadows for depth: glow effects, elevation, focus states

animation-library.easing-functions: - entrance: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) /* back-out */ - exit: cubic-bezier(0.32, 0, 0.67, 0) /* ease-in */ - interaction: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) /* ease-out */ - bounce: cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55)
animation-library.timing-standards: - micro: 150ms (hover, focus) - short: 300ms (transitions, reveals) - medium: 600ms (layout changes) - long: 1000ms (complex animations)

global-enhancements.accessibility-checklist: - [ ] 4.5:1 contrast ratios for all text - [ ] 44px minimum touch targets on mobile - [ ] Complete keyboard navigation - [ ] Screen reader compatibility - [ ] Focus management and trap - [ ] ARIA labels and descriptions - [ ] Motion reduction preferences - [ ] High contrast mode support
global-enhancements.performance-targets: - Bundle size increase: <50KB (with lazy loading) - Animation performance: 60fps on mid-range devices - Memory usage: <10MB additional for animations - Loading time impact: <200ms additional
